milestone.name: bounded proof-carrying finite evaluation passes zero-executor falsification
milestone.revision: A compile/test-style result can be replaced without external execution only when the complete operational semantics and all environment-sensitive premises are small enough to encode in a finite certificate that scheduled Chat can derive and re-check directly. Reproducibility and provenance bind source/environment/artifact facts but do not create a fresh build result; translation validation presupposes a produced target; zkVM receipts presuppose compilation plus prover execution.

smallest_test.environment_counterfactual: same source, pointer_bits=32,bits_per_byte=8, claimed RET_CONST(8) => expected 4, FAIL

tested_bounded_certificate.scope: tiny explicitly modeled finite semantics only

source_lockfile_reproducibility.reason: definition itself depends on same build environment and instructions; reproducing still means performing the build

preexisting_slsa_attestation.reason: useful to verify an already-built artifact, but provenance records an executed builder invocation

translation_validation.reason: validates an individual target translation after it exists

zkvm_receipt.reason: fresh receipt generation requires method compilation and prover/host execution

source_evidence.claim: Same source alone is not enough; build environment and build instructions are part of reproducibility, and relevant environment attributes include dependencies, flags and environment variables.
SLSA v1.2 provenance binds inputs/dependencies and identifies the builder, but explicitly models artifacts as outputs of an executed buildDefinition.
Translation validation checks each individual produced target against source semantics rather than eliminating target production.
Proof-carrying code motivates attaching a checkable proof/certificate to a result rather than trusting its producer.
RISC Zero verification consumes a receipt, but fresh receipt production first compiles a method and runs/proves it in the zkVM.

negative_evidence: Source+lockfile metadata cannot generally certify an environment-sensitive result if the relevant environment premise is omitted.
SLSA/in-toto-style provenance can make a preexisting artifact auditable but cannot make a missing fresh artifact appear without the build execution it records.
Translation validation is a checker of a produced translation, not a producer-free translation mechanism.
General zkVM/verifiable-computation receipts relocate trust to verification but still leave a prover/execution dependency for fresh receipts.
The bounded proof-carrying route must not be generalized to arbitrary compilers, dependency resolution, linking, OS/network/filesystem tests, performance behavior, or unmodeled compiler bugs.
still_unresolved: general environment-sensitive compile/test/dependency execution whose semantics cannot be finitely represented and derived inside scheduled Chat
opaque caller-keyless external effects under ambiguous completion
general byte-faithful scheduled-Chat readback of arbitrary binary and large-artifact scaling
protected or privileged authority unavailable to scheduled Chat

frontier.action: Generalize the finite proof-carrying evaluator to a precommitted small straight-line build-expression language: literals, integer arithmetic, declared environment variables/build flags, conditionals and dependency-digest equality. Require every environment read to appear in the certificate. Test positive and mutated-premise negatives and measure certificate/check steps versus expression size.

Audit certifying/proof-producing compiler literature for cases where certificate checking is substantially simpler than compilation. Accept only if scheduled Chat can also obtain or synthesize the fresh certificate with no external executor and zero optional quota; otherwise retain as partial verification only.

Combine preexisting signed provenance with the bounded proof layer for reuse-only cases: verify subject digest, environment/build parameters and a finite semantic claim without rebuilding. Test stale/mismatched environment and subject-digest negatives.

exact_next_action: Precommit a tiny straight-line proof-carrying build-expression grammar with literals, ADD/SUB/MUL/DIV_EXACT, ENV(name), IF_EQ and DIGEST_EQ. Define a linear checker that rejects undeclared ENV reads and missing dependency digests. Hand-derive three small certificates in scheduled Chat only: one valid flag-dependent artifact constant, one same-source changed-flag counterexample, and one dependency-digest mismatch. Record proof/check step counts and reject the candidate if any step requires compiler, SMT/Coq/zkVM, hosted CI, package service, user execution or finite monthly credits.
termination: intermediate Phase-1 checkpoint with nonempty frontier; global completion false; recurring role remains enabled
